title: Manual Clearance (Airway Management)
content_markdown:
#### Indications

- Upper airway obstruction.

#### Procedure

- Position patient in lateral position.

- Open mouth and visually inspect.

- Remove foreign matter with two ‘hooked’ fingers using a sweeping motion.

- Carefully remove dislodged or loose dentures.

- Perform triple airway manoeuvre.

- Check breathing: 
- Look, Listen and Feel for signs of respiration.
- If airway remains obstructed, use laryngoscope and Magill forceps to clear airway.

#### Contraindications

- Nil when indicated.

#### Complications

- Beware of being bitten.
- Beware of patients with suspected spinal injuries – log roll and maintain spinal alignment.

#### Specific Notes

- Wear PPE especially eye protection and gloves.
